name: Foundry: Pour Line
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: POUR LINE — THE FOUNDRY circuit's DOUBLE-debris run (tier 2; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 Foundry row 9). Molten droplets rain over TWO of four islands (B and C) on OFFSET schedules across a longer 4-island / 3-void run, so the traverse becomes a left-to-right pour line: spawn safe on A, FLY B dodging its droplets, FLY C dodging its OFFSET droplets, land safe on D. Debris family scaled up from the foundry_droplets on-ramp (two columns per hazarded island, tighter cadence). Tier 2.

DOCTRINE FIT: (1) LETHAL — a chunk overlap instakills via kill(&ring_out); chunks despawn on landing (no shove). (2) TELEGRAPHY — a growing ground shadow + pulsing hazard-red reticle for telegraph_lead 0.7s BEFORE each chunk exists. (3) FAIRNESS — two separate spawners: B columns x1600/2000 (start 0.7s), C columns x3000/3400 (start 1.45s, OFFSET) so the two islands never peak simultaneously; each runs cadence 1.5s with max_concurrent 1 (only one chunk per island at a time), leaving each island's edges + the mid-column band always safe; islands A and D are permanent debris-free refuges; symmetric. (4) CREDIT — a chunk kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1); a rival knocked under a marked column within the 6.0s ring-out window is credited; no environment scorer.

GEOMETRY (symmetric 4-island void_is_floor): four flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..800 / B x1400..2200 (debris) / C x2800..3600 (debris, offset) / D x4200..5000, all top y1080, separated by 600px void gaps. Bounds -600..5600 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>=650px recovery sky; outer edges 600px inside side blast lines). Molten open_sky (clouds off, horizon glow).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px => ~395px zero-boost drift; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 600px in ~0.85s):
- GAP A<->B (island edges x800..x1400 = 600px over void): > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2200..x2800 = 600px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- GAP C<->D (x3600..x4200 = 600px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE the droplets on B and C: step off a marked column during its 0.7s telegraph; with one chunk per island and offset schedules a safe standing spot on each island always exists. The debris falls on the island tops (not the crossing lanes) and never makes a required gap crossing uncrossable. Verb: DODGE (+ READ).
- Zero-boost off any island reaches NO other surface across a 600px gap: flight is REQUIRED; the debris reshapes/times the on-island fight.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the Foundry's longest debris traverse (foundry_droplets is a single island; the offset two-island pour makes the crossing a rhythm run). One-line read: 'time the pour across two smelt-decks and shove rivals under a droplet or into the gaps.'
